parts.zh: 最后是今晚的新闻，一名9岁男孩Joe在课堂上被禁止画画
Newcastle一家名为"Number 4"的餐厅联系了Joe的老师
Joe的爸爸说Joe是一个非常有天赋的小男孩
这只狗六岁半,最后被看到时戴着红色项圈
Kirsteen说:"只要他们不是对狗的失踪负有责任,我们会付钱给任何把它带回家的人。
M: 也许我们应该让Paul带上他的电脑和音箱
W: 嗯，如果你信任他的话
M: 没错。你完全不用担心

items.stem: What did Joe's parents decide to do?

choices.text: Enrol him in a Newcastle football club.
Send him to an after-school art class.
Forbid him to draw in his workbook.
choices.zh: 禁止他在作业本上画画。

choices.text: Help him post his drawings online.
choices.zh: 帮他把画作发布到网上。

items.stem: What did the restaurant "Number 4" do?

choices.text: Contacted Joe to decorate its dining-room.
Hired Joe to paint all the walls of its buildings.
choices.zh: 雇用Joe粉刷其建筑物的所有墙壁。

choices.text: Renovated its kitchen and all the dining-rooms.
choices.zh: 翻新了其厨房和所有餐厅。

choices.text: Asked Joe for permission to use his online drawings.
choices.zh: 请求Joe允许使用他在网上的画作。

items.stem: What is Kirsteen Marshall trying to do?

choices.text: Get her pet dog back.
Identify the suspect on the security video.
choices.zh: 辨认监控视频中的嫌疑人。

choices.text: Beg for help from the police.
Post pictures of her pet dog on social media.
choices.zh: 在社交媒体上发布她宠物狗的照片。

items.stem: What does the news report say about Kirsteen Marshall's family?

choices.text: It is suffering a great deal from the incident.
choices.zh: 他们正因这一事件遭受巨大痛苦。

choices.text: It is helping the police with the investigation.
choices.zh: 他们正在协助警方调查。

choices.text: It is bringing the case to the local district court.
choices.zh: 他们正在把案件提交到当地地方法院。

choices.text: It is offering a big reward to anyone who helps.
choices.zh: 他们正在向任何提供帮助的人提供丰厚奖励。

items.stem: What does Guy Wilson say his café aims to do?

choices.text: Provide free meals to the local poor.
choices.zh: 为当地穷人提供免费餐食。

choices.text: Help people connect with each other.
choices.zh: 帮助人们彼此建立联系。

choices.text: Help eliminate class difference in his area.
choices.zh: 帮助消除他所在地区的阶层差异。

choices.text: Provide customers with first-class service.
choices.zh: 为顾客提供一流的服务。

items.stem: What does the news report say about Eggs & Bread café?

choices.text: It does not supervise its employees.
It donates regularly to a local charity.
choices.zh: 它定期向当地慈善机构捐款。

choices.text: It does not use volunteers.
It is open round the clock.

items.stem: What happens when people start to know each other according to Guy Wilson?

choices.text: They will realise the importance of communication.
choices.zh: 他们会意识到沟通的重要性。

choices.text: They will come to the café even more frequently.
choices.zh: 他们会更频繁地来到这家咖啡馆。

choices.text: They will care less about their own background.
choices.zh: 他们会不那么在意自己的背景。

choices.text: They will find they have something in common.
choices.zh: 他们会发现彼此有共同之处。

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly talking about?

choices.text: A surprise party for Paul's birthday.
choices.zh: 为Paul的生日举办惊喜派对。

choices.text: Travel plans for the coming weekend.
choices.zh: 即将到来的周末的旅行计划。

choices.text: Preparations for Saturday's get-together.
The new market on the other side of town.

items.stem: Why does the woman say it is a good idea to serve foods that guests can help themselves to?

choices.text: It makes the hostess's job a whole lot easier.
choices.zh: 这让女主人的工作轻松了许多。

choices.text: It enables guests to walk around and chat freely.
choices.zh: 这让客人能够四处走动并自由交谈。

choices.text: It saves considerable time and labor.
choices.zh: 这节省了大量时间和劳动。

choices.text: It requires fewer tables and chairs.

items.stem: What does the woman say about the new supermarket?

choices.text: It offers some big discounts.
It is quite close to her house.
It is more spacious and less crowded.
It sells local wines and soft drinks.
choices.zh: 它出售当地的葡萄酒和软饮料。

items.stem: What does the man suggest they ask Paul to do?

choices.text: Cook a dish for the party.
Arrive 10 minutes earlier.
Prepare a few opening remarks.
Bring his computer and speakers.
choices.zh: 带上他的电脑和扬声器。

items.stem: Why does the woman want to have a car?

choices.text: For commuting to work.
For long-distance travel.
For getting around in Miami.
choices.zh: 为了在迈阿密四处出行。

choices.text: For convenience at weekends.

items.stem: What does the woman say about German cars?

choices.text: They are reliable.
They are compact.
They are spacious.
They are easy to drive.

items.stem: What does the man recommend the woman do?

choices.text: Buy a second-hand car.
Trust her own judgment.
Seek advice from his friend.
Look around before deciding.

items.stem: What do we learn about the man's friend from the conversation?

choices.text: He sells new cars.
He can be trusted.
He is starting a business.
He is a successful car dealer.
choices.zh: 他是一位成功的汽车经销商。

items.stem: What do we learn about early pigs in North America?

choices.text: Many escaped from farms and became wild.
choices.zh: 许多猪从农场逃脱并变成了野猪。

choices.text: They were actually native to North America.
choices.zh: 它们实际上原产于北美。

choices.text: Many got killed in the wild when searching for food.
choices.zh: 许多猪在野外觅食时被杀死。

choices.text: They were hunted by Spanish and Russian explorers.
choices.zh: 它们被西班牙和俄罗斯探险家猎杀。

items.stem: Why are wild pigs a threat to humans?

choices.text: They often make sudden attacks on people.
choices.zh: 它们经常对人发动突然袭击。

choices.text: They break up nature's food supply chain.
choices.zh: 它们破坏了自然界的食物供应链。

choices.text: They cause much environmental pollution.
choices.zh: 它们造成了严重的环境污染。

choices.text: They carry a great many diseases.

items.stem: What does the passage say about the native foxes on the US island?

choices.text: They lived peacefully with wild pigs.
They ran out of food completely.
choices.zh: 它们的食物完全耗尽了。

choices.text: They fell victim to eagles.
They reproduced quickly.

items.stem: What are a pair of entrepreneurs planning to do?

choices.text: Taste coffee while in outer space.
Roast coffee beans in outer space.
Develop a new strain of coffee bean.
choices.zh: 培育一种新的咖啡豆品种。

choices.text: Use a pressurised tank to brew coffee.

items.stem: What does the passage say about coffee beans roasted on Earth?

choices.text: They can easily get burned.
They float around in the oven.
choices.zh: 它们在烤箱中四处漂浮。

choices.text: They have to be heated to 360℃.
They receive evenly distributed heat.
choices.zh: 它们受到均匀分布的热量。

items.stem: What did the two Italian companies do in 2015?

choices.text: They charged a high price for their space-roasted coffee beans.
choices.zh: 它们为其太空烘焙的咖啡豆定了高价。

choices.text: They set up a branch in Dubai to manufacture coffee roasters.
choices.zh: 它们在Dubai设立分公司制造咖啡烘焙机。

choices.text: They collaborated on building the first space coffee machine.
choices.zh: 它们合作建造了第一台太空咖啡机。

choices.text: They abandoned the attempt to roast coffee beans in space.
choices.zh: 它们放弃了在太空烘焙咖啡豆的尝试。

items.stem: Why do a lot of people come to the village of Takotna every March?

choices.text: It is the best time for sightseeing.
A race passes through it annually.
choices.zh: 一场比赛每年都会经过这里。

choices.text: They come to clean the Iditarod Trail.
It is when the villagers choose a queen.
choices.zh: 这是村民们选举女王的时候。

items.stem: What is the village of Takotna famous for?

choices.text: Its children's baking skills.
Its unique winter scenery.
Its tasty fruit pies.
Its great food variety.

items.stem: Who comes to help with the event of the year?

choices.text: The contestants.
The entire village.
Jan Newton and her friends.
People from the state of Idaho.

items.stem: What does the passage say about Jan Newton?

choices.text: She owned a restaurant in Idaho.
She married her husband in 1972.
She went to Alaska to compete in a race.
She helped the village to become famous.
choices.zh: 她帮助这个村庄变得出名。
